en: Black-and-white image showing the ruins of a hilltop fortress with two prominent cylindrical stone towers. One tower is taller, with a conical roof structure and crenellations, while the other is shorter and more ruined, with missing masonry and an open top. The towers stand on rocky terrain above a slope dotted with small trees and shrubs; the background shows a rural, slightly hilly landscape. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.
